# Lisbon opens its first night-time tram line

*By Ana Ribeiro · Published March 5, 2024*

Lisbon's transport company [Carris](https://www.carris.pt) launched a night-time service on tram line 28 on Monday, the first time the city's historic trams have run after midnight.

“We expect around 3,000 riders a night in the first summer,” said Carris spokesperson João Matos.

The trams themselves are **Remodelado** cars, built in the 1930s and rebuilt by Carris in the 1990s. They share the line with the newer Siemens articulated trams on route 15, which compete for tourists with the city's tuk-tuk operators.

Critics argue that the night service will worsen noise in Alfama, while the city council says the line runs quieter than the buses it replaces.
